## Conversation Summary

1. **Goal**: Speed up a Jupyter notebook pipeline that summarizes project files using a local `llama_cpp` LLM, which was bottlenecked by a sequential `for` loop over files and chunks.

2. **Core change**: Reload the `Llama` model with `n_parallel=N_PARALLEL` (4 slots) and set `N_CTX = N_PARALLEL * 2048` so llama.cpp allocates multiple internal decode slots for concurrent batched inference.

3. **Thread safety**: A `threading.Semaphore(N_PARALLEL)` wraps every `_call_llm()` call, ensuring concurrent Python threads never submit more requests than available decode slots, preventing slot starvation and OOM.

4. **Parallel dispatch**: A new `summarize_file_parallel()` function fans out all chunks of a single file via an inner `ThreadPoolExecutor`; an outer `ThreadPoolExecutor(FILE_WORKERS=N_PARALLEL)` processes multiple files concurrently — both layers share the same semaphore gate.

5. **Deliverable**: The full notebook was regenerated with all four modified cells (Config, Load LLM, Summarizer, Pipeline) integrated cleanly while keeping all other cells (walker, chunker, guide builder, token check, GuideModel smoke-test) unchanged.

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from typing import Iterator\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def is_binary_file(path: Path, sample_bytes: int = 8192) -> bool:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Heuristic: a file is binary if its first *sample_bytes* contain a NUL byte.\"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with open(path, \"rb\") as fh:\n",
    "            chunk = fh.read(sample_bytes)\n",
    "        return b\"\\x00\" in chunk\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return True\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def iter_project_files(\n",
    "    root: str,\n",
    "    skip_dirs: set,\n",
    "    max_files: int = MAX_FILES,\n",
    ") -> Iterator[Path]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Yields Path objects for every **text** file under *root*,\n",
    "    skipping directories in *skip_dirs* and binary files.\n",
    "    Files are yielded in deterministic (sorted) order.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    root_path = Path(root)\n",
    "    count = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root_path, topdown=True):\n",
    "        dirnames[:] = sorted(\n",
    "            d for d in dirnames\n",
    "            if d not in skip_dirs and not d.startswith(\".\")\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        for filename in sorted(filenames):\n",
    "            if count >= max_files:\n",
    "                return\n",
    "            filepath = Path(dirpath) / filename\n",
    "            # Skip oversized files\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                if filepath.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:\n",
    "                    continue\n",
    "            except OSError:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            # Skip binary files\n",
    "            if is_binary_file(filepath):\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            yield filepath\n",
    "            count += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Quick sanity check\n",

    "from typing import List\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def read_file_chunks(\n",
    "    path: Path,\n",
    "    chunk_size: int = CHUNK_SIZE_CHARS,\n",
    "    max_chunks: int = MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE,\n",
    ") -> List[str]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Reads *path* as UTF-8 text and splits it into chunks of *chunk_size*\n",
    "    characters.  At most *max_chunks* chunks are returned.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Chunk boundaries are nudged to the nearest newline so that lines are\n",
    "    never split mid-way (best-effort).\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        print(f\"  [skip] Cannot read {path}: {exc}\")\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not text.strip():\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "\n",
    "    chunks: List[str] = []\n",
    "    start = 0\n",
    "    total = len(text)\n",
    "\n",
    "    while start < total and len(chunks) < max_chunks:\n",
    "        end = min(start + chunk_size, total)\n",
    "        # Nudge to the nearest newline after *end* (within 200 chars)\n",
    "        if end < total:\n",
    "            nl_pos = text.find(\"\\n\", end, end + 200)\n",
    "            if nl_pos != -1:\n",
    "                end = nl_pos + 1\n",
    "        chunk = text[start:end].strip()\n",
    "        if chunk:\n",
    "            chunks.append(chunk)\n",
    "        start = end\n",
    "\n",
    "    return chunks\n",
    "\n",

    "from typing import List\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Prompt templates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "_CHUNK_PROMPT_TMPL = \"\"\"You are a code documentation assistant.\n",
    "Analyze the following file chunk and respond with EXACTLY 2 lines:\n",
    "Line 1: A concise description of what this chunk does (max 20 words).\n",
    "Line 2: The most important keywords, comma-separated (max 10 keywords).\n",
    "Do NOT add any other text, headings, or explanation.\n",
    "\n",
    "File: {file_path}\n",
    "Chunk {chunk_index} of {total_chunks}:\n",
    "```\n",
    "{chunk_text}\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "Summary (2 lines only):\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "_FILE_PROMPT_TMPL = \"\"\"You are a code documentation assistant.\n",
    "Below are chunk summaries for a single file. Produce a FINAL summary of EXACTLY 2 lines:\n",
    "Line 1: A concise description of what the whole file does (max 20 words).\n",
    "Line 2: The most important keywords from the entire file, comma-separated (max 10 keywords).\n",
    "Do NOT add any other text, headings, or explanation.\n",
    "\n",
    "File: {file_path}\n",
    "Chunk summaries:\n",
    "{chunk_summaries}\n",
    "\n",
    "Final summary (2 lines only):\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Core summarization calls ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "def _call_llm(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 80) -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Sends *prompt* to the loaded LLM and returns the stripped response text.\n",
    "    Stops at a blank line or after *max_tokens* tokens.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    result = _llm(\n",
    "        prompt,\n",
    "        max_tokens=max_tokens,\n",
    "        temperature=0.1,     # low temperature for deterministic, factual output\n",
    "        top_p=0.9,\n",
    "        stop=[\"\\n\\n\\n\", \"```\", \"###\"],\n",
    "        echo=False,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    return result[\"choices\"][0][\"text\"].strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def summarize_chunk(\n",
    "    file_path: str,\n",
    "    chunk_text: str,\n",
    "    chunk_index: int,\n",
    "    total_chunks: int,\n",
    ") -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Returns a 2-line summary string for one file chunk.\n",
    "    Falls back to a truncated snippet if the LLM fails.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    prompt = _CHUNK_PROMPT_TMPL.format(\n",
    "        file_path=file_path,\n",
    "        chunk_index=chunk_index + 1,\n",
    "        total_chunks=total_chunks,\n",
    "        chunk_text=chunk_text[:CHUNK_SIZE_CHARS],   # guard against oversized chunks\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        return _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=80)\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        return f\"(summarization failed: {exc})\\n\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def summarize_file(\n",
    "    file_path: str,\n",
    "    chunk_summaries: List[str],\n",
    ") -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Collapses all per-chunk summaries into a single 2-line file summary.\n",
    "    If there is only one chunk, returns that chunk's summary directly.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not chunk_summaries:\n",
    "        return \"(empty file)\\n(no keywords)\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if len(chunk_summaries) == 1:\n",
    "        # Single chunk — already a valid 2-line summary\n",
    "        lines = chunk_summaries[0].splitlines()\n",
    "        line1 = lines[0].strip() if len(lines) > 0 else \"(no description)\"\n",
    "        line2 = lines[1].strip() if len(lines) > 1 else \"(no keywords)\"\n",
    "        return f\"{line1}\\n{line2}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    numbered = \"\\n\".join(\n",
    "        f\"[{i+1}] {s}\" for i, s in enumerate(chunk_summaries)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    prompt = _FILE_PROMPT_TMPL.format(\n",
    "        file_path=file_path,\n",
    "        chunk_summaries=numbered,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        return _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=80)\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        # Fallback: concatenate first lines from chunk summaries\n",
    "        first_lines = \" | \".join(s.splitlines()[0] for s in chunk_summaries if s)\n",
    "        return f\"{first_lines[:150]}\\n(keywords unavailable)\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"LLM summarizer defined ✓\")"

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def build_directory_tree(\n",
    "    root: str,\n",
    "    skip_dirs: set,\n",
    "    max_depth: int = 3,\n",
    "    max_children: int = 20,\n",
    ") -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Returns a compact ASCII directory tree string limited to *max_depth* levels.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    lines: List[str] = []\n",
    "    root_path = Path(root)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def _walk(path: Path, prefix: str, depth: int) -> None:\n",
    "        if depth > max_depth:\n",
    "            return\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            children = sorted(path.iterdir())\n",
    "        except PermissionError:\n",
    "            return\n",
    "\n",
    "        children = [\n",
    "            c for c in children\n",
    "            if not c.name.startswith(\".\") and c.name not in skip_dirs\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "        dirs   = [c for c in children if c.is_dir()]\n",
    "        files  = [c for c in children if c.is_file()]\n",
    "        visible = (dirs + files)[:max_children]\n",
    "        hidden  = len(dirs) + len(files) - len(visible)\n",
    "\n",
    "        for i, child in enumerate(visible):\n",
    "            is_last   = (i == len(visible) - 1) and hidden == 0\n",
    "            connector = \"└── \" if is_last else \"├── \"\n",
    "            suffix    = \"/\" if child.is_dir() else \"\"\n",
    "            lines.append(f\"{prefix}{connector}{child.name}{suffix}\")\n",
    "            if child.is_dir():\n",
    "                extension = \"    \" if is_last else \"│   \"\n",
    "                _walk(child, prefix + extension, depth + 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if hidden > 0:\n",
    "            lines.append(f\"{prefix}└── … ({hidden} more)\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    lines.append(f\"{root_path.name}/\")\n",
    "    _walk(root_path, \"\", 1)\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "tree = build_directory_tree(PROJECT_PATH, SKIP_DIRS, max_depth=3)\n",

    "from typing import Dict\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def build_guide(\n",
    "    project_name: str,\n",
    "    directory_tree: str,\n",
    "    file_summaries: Dict[str, str],\n",

def _strip_thinking(text: str) -> str:

    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)

    """
    Ensures output is exactly 2 non-empty lines.

    text = _strip_thinking(text)

# Benefits Discussion: Document Chunking with Parallel Slots

## Current Approach vs. Parallel Slots Approach

### Current Approach (Sequential)
- Documents are processed one by one
- Single context window utilized
- KV cache is cold for each new document
- Linear processing time: `O(n * chunk_time)`

### Parallel Slots Approach
- Multiple documents processed simultaneously
- Shared context across slots (`-c 32768` split across 4 slots = 8192 each)
- **KV cache reuse**: identical prefixes (system prompts, instructions) are cached once and reused
- Processing time: `O(n/slots * chunk_time)`

---

## Key Benefits

### 1. 🚀 Speed - Throughput Multiplier
```
Sequential:  [doc1] → [doc2] → [doc3] → [doc4]  = 4x time
Parallel:    [doc1]
             [doc2]  → all finish together = 1x time
             [doc3]
             [doc4]
```

### 2. 💾 KV Cache Reuse - Biggest Win
```
# System prompt + chunking instructions are IDENTICAL for all documents
# Without cache-reuse: encode system prompt N times
# With cache-reuse: encode system prompt ONCE, reuse for all N documents

Typical system prompt: ~500 tokens
100 documents = 500 * 100 = 50,000 tokens encoded (without reuse)
                500 * 1   =    500 tokens encoded (with reuse) ← 100x reduction
```

### 3. 🧠 Memory Efficiency
- Single model loaded in memory
- KV cache shared intelligently
- No multiple model instances needed

### 4. 📊 Better GPU Utilization
```
Sequential:  GPU [████░░░░░░░░] 33% utilized
Parallel:    GPU [████████████] 95% utilized
```

def _strip_thinking(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    return text.strip()


def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict:
    text = _strip_thinking(text)
    match = re.search(r"\{.*?\}", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        try:
            return json.loads(match.group())
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return {"description": text[:120].strip(), "keywords": []}


def _normalize_summary(raw: dict) -> ChunkSummary:
    description = str(raw.get("description", "(no description)")).strip()
    keywords_raw = raw.get("keywords", [])
    if isinstance(keywords_raw, str):
        keywords = [k.strip() for k in keywords_raw.split(",") if k.strip()]
    elif isinstance(keywords_raw, list):
        keywords = [str(k).strip() for k in keywords_raw if k]
    else:
        keywords = []
    return ChunkSummary(
        description=description[:200],
        keywords=keywords[:10],

# ── Core LLM call — semaphore-guarded for parallel safety ────────────────────

def _call_llm(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 120) -> str:
    """
    Sends *prompt* to the loaded LLM.
    The semaphore ensures at most N_PARALLEL calls run concurrently,
    matching the number of decode slots allocated at model load time.
    """
    with _llm_semaphore:
        result = _llm(
            prompt,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=0.1,
            top_p=0.9,
            stop=["\n\n\n", "File:", "Chunk ", "<|im_start|>"],
            echo=False,
        )
    raw = result["choices"][0]["text"].strip()
    return _strip_thinking(raw)

def summarize_chunk(
    file_path: str,
    chunk_text: str,
    chunk_index: int,
    total_chunks: int,
    chunk_size_chars: int = 1500,
) -> ChunkSummary:
    prompt = _CHUNK_PROMPT_TMPL.format(
        file_path=file_path,
        chunk_index=chunk_index + 1,
        total_chunks=total_chunks,
        chunk_text=chunk_text[:chunk_size_chars],
    )
    try:
        raw_text = _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=120)
        return _normalize_summary(_extract_json(raw_text))
    except Exception as exc:
        return ChunkSummary(
            description=f"(summarization failed: {exc})",
            keywords=[],
        )


def summarize_file(
    file_path: str,
    chunk_summaries: List[ChunkSummary],
) -> FileSummary:
    if not chunk_summaries:
        return FileSummary(
            path=file_path,
            description="(empty or unreadable file)",
            keywords=[],
        )
    if len(chunk_summaries) == 1:
        s = chunk_summaries[0]
        return FileSummary(
            path=file_path,
            description=s["description"],
            keywords=s["keywords"],
        )
    numbered = "\n".join(
        f"[{i+1}] {s['description']} | keywords: {', '.join(s['keywords'])}"
        for i, s in enumerate(chunk_summaries)
    )
    prompt = _FILE_PROMPT_TMPL.format(
        file_path=file_path,
        chunk_summaries=numbered,
    )
    try:
        raw_text = _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=120)
        normalized = _normalize_summary(_extract_json(raw_text))
        return FileSummary(
            path=file_path,
            description=normalized["description"],
            keywords=normalized["keywords"],
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        merged_desc = " | ".join(s["description"] for s in chunk_summaries)
        merged_kw   = list({kw for s in chunk_summaries for kw in s["keywords"]})
        return FileSummary(
            path=file_path,
            description=merged_desc[:200],
            keywords=merged_kw[:10],
        )


# ── NEW: parallel file summarizer ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def summarize_file_parallel(fp: Path, root_path: Path) -> tuple[str, FileSummary]:
    """
    Reads, chunks, and summarizes a single file.
    Designed to run inside a ThreadPoolExecutor worker.
    Returns (rel_path_str, FileSummary).
    """
    rel = str(fp.relative_to(root_path))
    chunks = read_file_chunks(fp)

    if not chunks:
        return rel, FileSummary(
            path=rel,
            description="(empty or unreadable file)",
            keywords=[],
        )

    # Summarize all chunks of THIS file in parallel sub-threads
    # Each chunk summary is an independent LLM call → perfect for slots
    chunk_sums: List[ChunkSummary] = [None] * len(chunks)

    def _do_chunk(args):
        idx, chunk = args
        return idx, summarize_chunk(rel, chunk, idx, len(chunks))

    # Use min(len(chunks), N_PARALLEL) workers — no point spawning more than slots
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(len(chunks), N_PARALLEL)) as chunk_pool:
        futures = {chunk_pool.submit(_do_chunk, (i, c)): i for i, c in enumerate(chunks)}
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            idx, summary = future.result()
            chunk_sums[idx] = summary

    return rel, summarize_file(rel, chunk_sums)

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from typing import Iterator\n",

    "\n",
    "def is_binary_file(path: Path, sample_bytes: int = 8192) -> bool:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Heuristic: a file is binary if its first *sample_bytes* contain a NUL byte.\"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with open(path, \"rb\") as fh:\n",
    "            chunk = fh.read(sample_bytes)\n",
    "        return b\"\\x00\" in chunk\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return True\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def iter_project_files(\n",
    "    root: str,\n",
    "    skip_dirs: set,\n",
    "    max_files: int = MAX_FILES,\n",
    ") -> Iterator[Path]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Yields Path objects for every **text** file under *root*,\n",
    "    skipping directories in *skip_dirs* and binary files.\n",
    "    Files are yielded in deterministic (sorted) order.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    root_path = Path(root)\n",
    "    count = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root_path, topdown=True):\n",
    "        dirnames[:] = sorted(\n",
    "            d for d in dirnames\n",
    "            if d not in skip_dirs and not d.startswith(\".\")\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        for filename in sorted(filenames):\n",
    "            if count >= max_files:\n",
    "                return\n",
    "            filepath = Path(dirpath) / filename\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                if filepath.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:\n",

    "            except OSError:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if is_binary_file(filepath):\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            yield filepath\n",
    "            count += 1\n",

    "from typing import List\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def read_file_chunks(\n",
    "    path: Path,\n",
    "    chunk_size: int = CHUNK_SIZE_CHARS,\n",
    "    max_chunks: int = MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE,\n",
    ") -> List[str]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Reads *path* as UTF-8 text and splits it into chunks of *chunk_size*\n",
    "    characters.  At most *max_chunks* chunks are returned.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Chunk boundaries are nudged to the nearest newline so that lines are\n",
    "    never split mid-way (best-effort).\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        print(f\"  [skip] Cannot read {path}: {exc}\")\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not text.strip():\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "\n",
    "    chunks: List[str] = []\n",
    "    start = 0\n",
    "    total = len(text)\n",
    "\n",
    "    while start < total and len(chunks) < max_chunks:\n",
    "        end = min(start + chunk_size, total)\n",
    "        if end < total:\n",
    "            nl_pos = text.find(\"\\n\", end, end + 200)\n",
    "            if nl_pos != -1:\n",
    "                end = nl_pos + 1\n",
    "        chunk = text[start:end].strip()\n",
    "        if chunk:\n",
    "            chunks.append(chunk)\n",
    "        start = end\n",
    "\n",
    "    return chunks\n",
    "\n",

    "- **file prompt**  — given all chunk summaries for one file, collapse to a final 2-line summary\n",

    "### Parallelism strategy\n",
    "\n",
    "- `llama_cpp` compiled with `n_parallel > 1` batches requests across slots internally.\n",
    "- A `threading.Semaphore(N_PARALLEL)` caps concurrent Python-side calls to exactly\n",
    "  the number of slots, preventing slot starvation and OOM.\n",
    "- The GIL is released inside the C++ `llama_decode` call, so `ThreadPoolExecutor`\n",
    "  gives real parallelism without the overhead of `multiprocessing`."

    "from typing import List, TypedDict\n",
    "import re\n",
    "import json\n",
    "import threading\n",
    "from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Semaphore — caps concurrent LLM calls to N_PARALLEL ──────────────────────\n",
    "# Must be recreated here (after N_PARALLEL is defined) so re-running the cell\n",
    "# picks up any config changes.\n",
    "_llm_semaphore = threading.Semaphore(N_PARALLEL)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Output schema ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "class ChunkSummary:\n",
    "    def __init__(self, description: str, keywords: List[str]):\n",
    "        self.description = description\n",
    "        self.keywords    = keywords\n",
    "\n",
    "    def __str__(self) -> str:\n",
    "        kw = \", \".join(self.keywords)\n",
    "        return f\"{self.description}. Keywords: {kw}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    def __getitem__(self, key: str):\n",
    "        return getattr(self, key)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def get(self, key: str, default=None):\n",
    "        return getattr(self, key, default)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class FileSummary:\n",
    "    def __init__(self, path: str, description: str, keywords: List[str]):\n",
    "        self.path        = path\n",
    "        self.description = description\n",
    "        self.keywords    = keywords\n",
    "\n",
    "    def __str__(self) -> str:\n",
    "        kw = \", \".join(self.keywords)\n",
    "        return f\"{self.description}. Keywords: {kw}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    def __getitem__(self, key: str):\n",
    "        return getattr(self, key)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def get(self, key: str, default=None):\n",
    "        return getattr(self, key, default)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Prompt templates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "_CHUNK_PROMPT_TMPL = \"\"\"<|im_start|>system\n",
    "You are a concise code documentation assistant.\n",
    "Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else.\n",
    "Schema: {{\"description\": \"<max 20 words>\", \"keywords\": [\"kw1\", \"kw2\", ...]}}<|im_end|>\n",
    "<|im_start|>user\n",
    "File: {file_path} (chunk {chunk_index}/{total_chunks})\n",
    "\n",
    "{chunk_text}\n",
    "\n",
    "Write a JSON object:\n",
    "- \"description\": what this chunk does (max 20 words).\n",
    "- \"keywords\": array of strings (max 10).<|im_end|>\n",
    "<|im_start|>assistant\n",
    "\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "_FILE_PROMPT_TMPL = \"\"\"<|im_start|>system\n",
    "You are a concise code documentation assistant.\n",
    "Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else.\n",
    "Schema: {{\"description\": \"<max 20 words>\", \"keywords\": [\"kw1\", \"kw2\", ...]}}<|im_end|>\n",
    "<|im_start|>user\n",
    "Chunk summaries for file: {file_path}\n",
    "\n",
    "{chunk_summaries}\n",
    "\n",
    "Write a JSON object:\n",
    "- \"description\": what the whole file does (max 20 words).\n",
    "- \"keywords\": array of strings (max 10).<|im_end|>\n",
    "<|im_start|>assistant\n",
    "\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "def _strip_thinking(text: str) -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Remove <think>...</think> blocks emitted by reasoning models.\"\"\"\n",
    "    text = re.sub(r\"<think>.*?</think>\", \"\", text, flags=re.DOTALL)\n",
    "    return text.strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Extracts the first JSON object found in *text*.\n",
    "    Falls back to a default structure if parsing fails.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    text = _strip_thinking(text)\n",
    "    match = re.search(r\"\\{.*?\\}\", text, flags=re.DOTALL)\n",
    "    if match:\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            return json.loads(match.group())\n",
    "        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        return json.loads(text)\n",
    "    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n",
    "        return {\"description\": text[:120].strip(), \"keywords\": []}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _normalize_summary(raw: dict) -> ChunkSummary:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Ensures the parsed dict conforms to ChunkSummary schema.\n",
    "    Coerces types and enforces limits.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    description = str(raw.get(\"description\", \"(no description)\")).strip()\n",
    "    keywords_raw = raw.get(\"keywords\", [])\n",
    "\n",
    "    if isinstance(keywords_raw, str):\n",
    "        keywords = [k.strip() for k in keywords_raw.split(\",\") if k.strip()]\n",
    "    elif isinstance(keywords_raw, list):\n",
    "        keywords = [str(k).strip() for k in keywords_raw if k]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        keywords = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    return ChunkSummary(\n",
    "        description=description[:200],\n",
    "        keywords=keywords[:10],\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Core LLM call — semaphore-guarded ─────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "def _call_llm(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 120) -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Sends *prompt* to the loaded LLM and returns the stripped response text.\n",
    "\n",
    "    The semaphore ensures at most N_PARALLEL calls run concurrently,\n",
    "    matching the number of decode slots allocated at model load time.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    with _llm_semaphore:\n",
    "        result = _llm(\n",
    "            prompt,\n",
    "            max_tokens=max_tokens,\n",
    "            temperature=0.1,\n",
    "            top_p=0.9,\n",
    "            stop=[\"\\n\\n\\n\", \"File:\", \"Chunk \", \"<|im_start|>\"],\n",
    "            echo=False,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    raw = result[\"choices\"][0][\"text\"].strip()\n",
    "    return _strip_thinking(raw)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "def summarize_chunk(\n",
    "    file_path: str,\n",
    "    chunk_text: str,\n",
    "    chunk_index: int,\n",
    "    total_chunks: int,\n",
    "    chunk_size_chars: int = 1500,\n",

    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Returns a ChunkSummary (description + keywords list) for one file chunk.\n",
    "    Falls back to a safe default if the LLM fails or returns malformed JSON.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    prompt = _CHUNK_PROMPT_TMPL.format(\n",
    "        file_path=file_path,\n",
    "        chunk_index=chunk_index + 1,\n",
    "        total_chunks=total_chunks,\n",
    "        chunk_text=chunk_text[:chunk_size_chars],\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        raw_text = _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=120)\n",
    "        return _normalize_summary(_extract_json(raw_text))\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        return ChunkSummary(\n",
    "            description=f\"(summarization failed: {exc})\",\n",
    "            keywords=[],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def summarize_file(\n",
    "    file_path: str,\n",
    "    chunk_summaries: List[ChunkSummary],\n",
    ") -> FileSummary:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Collapses all per-chunk ChunkSummary objects into a single FileSummary.\n",
    "    If there is only one chunk, its summary is returned directly.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not chunk_summaries:\n",
    "        return FileSummary(\n",
    "            path=file_path,\n",
    "            description=\"(empty or unreadable file)\",\n",
    "            keywords=[],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    if len(chunk_summaries) == 1:\n",
    "        s = chunk_summaries[0]\n",
    "        return FileSummary(\n",
    "            path=file_path,\n",
    "            description=s[\"description\"],\n",
    "            keywords=s[\"keywords\"],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    numbered = \"\\n\".join(\n",
    "        f\"[{i+1}] {s['description']} | keywords: {', '.join(s['keywords'])}\"\n",
    "        for i, s in enumerate(chunk_summaries)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    prompt = _FILE_PROMPT_TMPL.format(\n",
    "        file_path=file_path,\n",
    "        chunk_summaries=numbered,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        raw_text = _call_llm(prompt, max_tokens=120)\n",
    "        normalized = _normalize_summary(_extract_json(raw_text))\n",
    "        return FileSummary(\n",
    "            path=file_path,\n",
    "            description=normalized[\"description\"],\n",
    "            keywords=normalized[\"keywords\"],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        merged_desc = \" | \".join(s[\"description\"] for s in chunk_summaries)\n",
    "        merged_kw   = list({kw for s in chunk_summaries for kw in s[\"keywords\"]})\n",
    "        return FileSummary(\n",
    "            path=file_path,\n",
    "            description=merged_desc[:200],\n",
    "            keywords=merged_kw[:10],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Parallel file summarizer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "def summarize_file_parallel(fp: Path, root_path: Path) -> tuple:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Reads, chunks, and summarizes a single file using parallel slot calls.\n",
    "    All chunks of the file are dispatched concurrently into the slot pool.\n",
    "    Returns (rel_path_str, FileSummary).\n",
    "\n",
    "    Designed to run inside a ThreadPoolExecutor worker.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    rel    = str(fp.relative_to(root_path))\n",
    "    chunks = read_file_chunks(fp)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not chunks:\n",
    "        return rel, FileSummary(\n",
    "            path=rel,\n",
    "            description=\"(empty or unreadable file)\",\n",
    "            keywords=[],\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Fan out all chunks of this file concurrently.\n",
    "    # Workers are capped to N_PARALLEL — no point exceeding slot count.\n",
    "    chunk_sums: List[ChunkSummary] = [None] * len(chunks)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def _do_chunk(args):\n",
    "        idx, chunk = args\n",
    "        return idx, summarize_chunk(rel, chunk, idx, len(chunks))\n",
    "\n",
    "    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(len(chunks), N_PARALLEL)) as pool:\n",
    "        futures = {pool.submit(_do_chunk, (i, c)): i for i, c in enumerate(chunks)}\n",
    "        for future in as_completed(futures):\n",
    "            idx, summary = future.result()\n",
    "            chunk_sums[idx] = summary\n",
    "\n",
    "    return rel, summarize_file(rel, chunk_sums)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"LLM summarizer (parallel, {N_PARALLEL} slots) defined ✓\")"

    "def build_directory_tree(\n",
    "    root: str,\n",

    "    max_depth: int = 3,\n",
    "    max_children: int = 20,\n",

    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Returns a compact ASCII directory tree string limited to *max_depth* levels.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    lines: List[str] = []\n",
    "    root_path = Path(root)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def _walk(path: Path, prefix: str, depth: int) -> None:\n",
    "        if depth > max_depth:\n",
    "            return\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            children = sorted(path.iterdir())\n",
    "        except PermissionError:\n",
    "            return\n",
    "\n",
    "        children = [\n",
    "            c for c in children\n",
    "            if not c.name.startswith(\".\") and c.name not in skip_dirs\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "        dirs    = [c for c in children if c.is_dir()]\n",
    "        files   = [c for c in children if c.is_file()]\n",
    "        visible = (dirs + files)[:max_children]\n",
    "        hidden  = len(dirs) + len(files) - len(visible)\n",
    "\n",
    "        for i, child in enumerate(visible):\n",
    "            is_last   = (i == len(visible) - 1) and hidden == 0\n",
    "            connector = \"└── \" if is_last else \"├── \"\n",
    "            suffix    = \"/\" if child.is_dir() else \"\"\n",

    "            if child.is_dir():\n",
    "                extension = \"    \" if is_last else \"│   \"\n",
    "                _walk(child, prefix + extension, depth + 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if hidden > 0:\n",
    "            lines.append(f\"{prefix}└── … ({hidden} more)\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    lines.append(f\"{root_path.name}/\")\n",
    "    _walk(root_path, \"\", 1)\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n",
